title: Tronota Utqaylla apamuq
intro: Atiyniyoq kamachikuqpa cortenpin mana atikuq mañakuyta ruwaqku, askhataqmi atipanakurqanku allin kasqankuta rikuchinankupaq. Chaywanpas chay ruwaytaqa hunt’akunmanmi karqan pichus Diospa yachayninwan tupasqanqa llapa aychapi atiyninta atiparqan, chaymi huk ratota rikuchirqan, chay ratoqa pachakunaq pasasqanman hinan uyarikunan karqan.
clues: Huk hatun reypa servicionpin kasharqani, payqa profetataqmi karqan, aswan confiasqan muyu ukhupitaqmi sayarqani.
Manam nina unanchasqachu karqani nitaq ancha kallpasapa runachu karqani, ichaqa aswan atiyniyoq kaqtan hap’irqani.
Karu suyumanta kamachikuq tiyanata apamunankupaq rey mañakuqtinmi allinta yacharqani imatachus ruwanayta.
Rimarqanin Qelqamanta yachayniymanta, manaraq pipas imatapas ruwashaqtinmi kamachikuy tiyanata reypa ñawpaqenman churasqa karqan.
Ruwasqayqa manan atiyniywanchu karqan, aswanpas cheqaq yachayqa Allahmantallan hamun chayta rikuchiymi.
Ñuqam kani Seba Reinapa kamachikuy tiyananta ñawi ch’ipiyllapi apamuq, Surah An-Naml nisqapi qelqasqa hina.

arabic: قَالَ ٱلَّذِى عِندَهُۥ عِلْمٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن يَرْتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا عِندَهُۥ قَالَ هَـٰذَا مِن فَضْلِ رَبِّى لِيَبْلُوَنِىٓ ءَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ ۖ وَمَن شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّى غَنِىٌّۭ كَرِيمٌۭ
verse: Said one who had knowledge from the Scripture, "I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you." And when [Solomon] saw it placed before him, he said, "This is from the favor of my Lord to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful. And whoever is grateful - his gratitude is only for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever is ungrateful - then indeed, my Lord is Free of need and Generous." (27:40)
